[tense] “Hey dude! fancy a sandwich?” I handed him the sandwich. He ate it without a comment. After finishing it he took a sip of beer, eructed, and kept on mumbling. I decided to go home.

Suddenly, I started hearing the voices once again. “Am I going crazy?” I thought. 

”...”

 “I must be dreaming all of this.”

”...”

Much to my relief, I came back to reality when he suddenly spat out:
“Sunflower.”
“One of a hundred.”

I kept listening, and he started vomiting words all over, shouting and moving his arms around. 
“will come the time and surely this time has come and past and come AGAIN till it passes away if only no one would PASS AWAY, y’know??
play would stop reap shot poison bomb the one we could keep doin keep gofin, keep moving forward! y'know? save it if you can save it yourself and don't waste my time, hey dude don’t waste my time, yesterday is gone tomorrow won't come just shut up SHUT UP and bend low bend down!!”

He sat silent, eyes closed. I bent down and closed my eyes as well. Completely alienated from the world of cars and  pedestrians passing by, I thought of my sunflower. That pacified my mind. Pacified my mind. Pacified my mind. When I opened my eyes again I found some ugly letters carved in the pavement. They read:
To save the sunflower you must
Control the water
Stop war
Steal the food
Make love stay
Drink the poison
The hobo looked at me with sparkly eyes. “I made up the last one, so don’t take it so seriously haha” He explained proudly, grinning his rotten teeth at me. “Want some?” And he offered me a glass bottle reeking of alcohol.

“Sure.”

”I’ll pass this time.”

“Sure” I said, accepting the booze and taking a long gulp. “Y’now” He said eventually “I wouldn't like to be in your position, much responsibility. Anyway, no hurry eh, me I just chillin man, just take it easy. Take your time. It is not like we are going anywhere.” He told me. For once I forgot about it all.

”Isn’t that your marker?” I asked
”Well, that’s a really common marker,” he replied before falling soundly asleep. I went home.

... sat on a dusty old sofa and did nothing till the moon peeked through the clouds.
The world seemed to be turning just fine.

... sat on this dusty old sofa and did nothing for a while til the shadows moved.
The world seemed to be turning just fine.

I walked in and stumbled upon the street sweeper.  The room was big and empty, and he was holding a gun!

“Holy sunflowers! I hope you’re not gonna kill me with that...”

“Uhm... I was just casually passing by...”

“Yes! I knew something smelled fishy...”

“Holly sunflowers, I hope you are not going to kill me with that!” I cried. He cried back.
“Will you just chill down a second? I'm not killing anyone”

What are you doing here?

Why don’t you give me that weapon?

What are you going to do with that?

There must be a way I could open this door before this guy gets here

“What are you doing here?” I asked the guy.

Are you dealing with weapons?.

Are you planning to kill my neighbour?.

Are you planning to kill my plant?

I trust you won't do anything stupid

''Are you dealing with weapons?'' I guessed stupidly. His face relaxed and he giggled in relief.
''Of course I'm not. I don’t like weapons myself. I’m here to destroy it and fulfill my sacred duty within the Order and the Sunflower. There’s no need to worry, my brother. The sunflower is safe, now. You should go home and be with who you love most.'' He said, tears in his eyes.

I rushed in and stumbled upon him.

Are you dealing with weapons?

Are you planning to kill my neighbour?

I kept looking for a few more sweaty minutes. Eventually the guy managed to start a fire and destroy whatever artifact he had been holding. I left before he could stumble upon me by the door, feeling quite unsure about what exactly had happened there.

... got the hell out of there before someone came and got the wrong idea.

I tried to open it by pushing against it, but the door was locked solid. There was nothing I could do here without better tools.

Once I got there, I...

...went to get some pizza...

...went to the toilet...

...approached the hobo sitting on the sidewalk next door...

...went to look for some pizza behind the counter...

... went to look for some pizza behind the counter. In one of the cupboards I found a very suspicious bottle. I grabbed it and...

drank it...

... read the label...
